detail: 45 of 48 features can be reconstructed exactly from transaction data at decision time. 3 features (user_fraud_rate, merch_fraud_rate, city_fraud_rate) require confirmed fraud labels that are unavailable at scoring time.
cold_start_behavior: Production defaults to 0.001 (COLD_START_FRAUD_RATE) when insufficient history exists. This is a constant, not a computed value.
